expected_level_description: You can: - direct the approach to content management to ensure content is regularly reviewed and evaluated by publishing or service teams - identify opportunities to improve content workflows, efficiency and scalability - define and manage relationships between content in complex systems

You can: - communicate design strategy across organisational boundaries - coach others in how to effectively communicate design - develop or introduce more effective methods of communicating design and working in the open

You can: - improve the practice of inclusive, accessible and environmentally sustainable design in multiple teams or across your organisation against measurable criteria - help others understand and mitigate potential barriers, biases and assumptions that may exclude or harm users

You can: - work with leaders to ensure that design is part of developing organisational strategy, and involved early enough in policy, technology and delivery processes to inform effective decision making - enable use of patterns and components across the organisation - help teams align their work to the goals and vision of their organisation

You can: - effectively plan and run design sessions that include senior leaders or stakeholders - coach other designers in how to involve stakeholders of any level in the design process - develop or introduce more effective ways to design together - help teams connect and work across organisational boundaries

You can: - embed a practice of hypothesis-driven design in a team - guide the organisation in how to use evidence to improve content or services - analyse, synthesise and use evidence to improve the way the organisation works - ensure user insights are shared with and used by the wider organisation and across government

You can: - embed the practice of iterative design and agile working in teams or wider organisation - guide designers in creating materials to test complex ideas at any fidelity - help teams adapt quickly to changes in requirements, priorities or user needs - iterate delivery processes or team structures to help teams work effectively

You can: - lead and coordinate design work for a team - advocate for user-centred design with leaders outside of digital and data - create an inclusive, productive environment for designers to work in - mentor and coach other designers - iterate and improve design processes within your team

You can: - analyse how a service fits into care pathways across organisations - work with clinicians, care staff, and patients to shape digital services - explain the effect of digital decisions on care, safety, and staff workload

You can: - set the organisation's standards for health information content and its clinical assurance - lead content strategy for health information across services and channels - advise senior clinical and communications leaders on health information risks
You can: - carry out equality impact assessments - build inclusive teams and practices
You can: - find and use the right codes for a data item or form - use terminology browsers and reference sets

skill: Designing for clinical safety and human factors
expected_level_description: You can: - design interfaces that make the safe action the easy action, for example by reducing ambiguous labels and needless alerts - test designs in realistic clinical scenarios, including interruptions and time pressure - raise design-related hazards with the clinical safety officer and record how designs control them
You can: - line manage a team, setting objectives and running appraisals - support wellbeing and manage attendance, performance, and conduct - plan the team's development and succession
